Visual merchandising / Selected project

2023
Spring

A visual merchandising concept for Zara’s Spring collection, bringing fashion, accessories, and the store environment together.

01 / The brief

Make the collection feel connected

As a visual merchandise assistant, the goal was to determine the best placement for the Spring collection and bring in complementary accessories to strengthen its visual story.

02 / The concept

Pattern for spring

Feminine shapes and urban patterns meet the Spring collection in a story that feels both expressive and gentle. The display gives the collection a clear point of view while making room for the details that complete it.

Accessories communicate with the collection simultaneously.

03 / In store

A space for spring

Placing the accessories in the right store space completes the Spring collection. Their position helps customers see how each piece works with the larger story.

04 / The result

Design that connects

The success of the Spring 2023 collection relies on strong customer connections with the design aligned to it.

The materials shown are used for illustrative purposes only and do not originate from Zara.
